storage.truncated: Note: the scan stopped at its bound ({entries} entries / {depth} levels); the numbers are a lower bound.

storage.notice:
Counts only: no file names or contents are shown. File contents were not read; symlinked or special files were skipped rather than followed.

Nothing was deleted or moved here. Cleaning up sessions or shared stores is an explicit offline decision, and DSH keeps its own source of truth.
plugins.title: DSH Ocean plugins
plugins.failure: Could not read the web profile's package.json. It must be readable, valid JSON, a regular non-symlink file and at most 1 MiB. Nothing was changed.
plugins.empty:
No plugins are declared in the web profile.

DSH manages its own plugin set; this window only reports what the profile declares.
plugins.summary: {bundles} bundle(s) and {packages} package dependency(ies) are declared by the web profile.
plugins.notice: Read-only: names and versions only, never file contents or paths. Installing, removing or updating plugins is DSH's job, not this window's.
downloads.history.title: DSH Ocean downloads
downloads.history.empty: No downloads recorded. Saving always asks for a new destination file.
downloads.history.selection_hint: Choose one active transfer. Saved/publishing files are not affected.
downloads.history.clear_ok: Finished metadata cleared from this view. Saved and staging files were not removed.
downloads.history.clear_failed: Cleared in memory only: history could not be saved. Previous entries may return after restart. No files were removed.
downloads.history.cancel_none: No selected/current active transfers to cancel. Saved files were not touched.
downloads.history.cancel_requested: Cancellation requested for these active network transfers. Saved files and transfers already publishing are not affected; see terminal status in history.
downloads.history.cancel_unavailable: Cancellation is unavailable or already pending. Saved files were not touched.
verification.failure: Could not verify the selected configuration snapshot. It may be incomplete, changed, unsupported or unreadable. No snapshot/profile files, services or packages were changed. Raw paths and file contents are not displayed here. The explicit --verify-profile-backup CLI offers local operator diagnostics; do not share them without checking for private metadata.
verification.working: Checking bounded snapshot structure and checksums. Cancel is cooperative at hash/metadata checkpoints and may wait for an in-flight filesystem operation.
verification.cancelling: Cancellation requested; waiting for the current filesystem operation/checkpoint. The worker is not forcibly killed.
verification.busy: Wait for the selected snapshot check to finish. This screen is not running a restore.
verification.cancelled: The read-only verification work has finished. Cancellation was requested before result commitment; no successful verification is claimed. No snapshot/profile files, services or packages were changed.
backup_history.title: DSH Ocean backup history
backup_history.failure: Could not read the backup folder. Check that it exists and that you own the files, then try again. No files were changed.
backup_history.empty:
No configuration backups found.

Use "Back up web configuration…" to create one.
backup_history.config_count: {count} configuration backup(s), {bytes} configuration bytes in total.
backup_history.data_count: {count} whole-data snapshot(s) (sessions and shared stores), {bytes} bytes in total:
backup_history.notice:
Checksums are not signatures: this list does not prove authenticity, a frozen snapshot or that other writers were stopped. Profile files can contain secrets. Listing reads snapshot manifests only.

Restoring and pruning remain explicit offline CLI operations; nothing was changed from this window.
backup.busy: Wait for the runtime update before creating a profile snapshot.
backup.saved:
Saved privately to:
{path}

Scope: web profile configuration only. Global credentials, sessions and node_modules are excluded. Profile files may themselves contain secrets.

A live snapshot is best-effort; stop other writers for stronger consistency. Restore requires the offline CLI command and retains the replaced profile.
backup.saved_log: Web profile configuration snapshot saved at {path}
data_snapshot.title: DSH Ocean data snapshot
data_snapshot.confirm:
Copy sessions and shared stores into a new snapshot?

Sessions: {session_files} file(s), {session_bytes} bytes
Shared stores: {storage_files} file(s), {storage_bytes} bytes
Total to copy: {total} bytes

The copies go to the configured backup folder and can be several gigabytes; make sure that folder has free space. The live data is only read, never moved or deleted, and DSH may keep writing while the copy runs, so this is a point-in-time best-effort copy rather than a frozen one.

Restoring a snapshot is an explicit offline command and is not offered here.
data_snapshot.result:
Snapshot created: {files} file(s), {bytes} bytes.

Verify it with `dsh-ocean --verify-data-backup <snapshot>`; the snapshot may contain conversation content, so keep the backup folder private.
data_snapshot.inconsistent: Note: sessions or stores changed while the copy ran, so this is a best-effort point-in-time copy. Stop DSH writers for a frozen snapshot.
data_snapshot.failure: The snapshot could not be created. Existing snapshots and live data were not changed.
data_snapshot.cancelled: The snapshot was cancelled. Live data was not changed; an incomplete staging copy was removed.
data_snapshot.busy: A data snapshot is already being created in this session.
data_snapshot.cancelling: Cancellation requested; the copy stops after the current file and the staging copy is removed.
export.title: DSH Ocean export backup
export.exported:
{files} file(s), {bytes} bytes written to the archive you chose.

The archive is unsigned: it proves integrity against its own manifest, not who created it. Verify it with `dsh-ocean --verify-export` before relying on a copy you did not create.
export.cancelled: Export cancelled. The partial archive was removed and the snapshot is unchanged.
export.failure: The export did not finish. No snapshot was modified; a partial archive was removed.
export.unsupported:
The selected folder is not a complete Ocean snapshot.

{error}
export.busy: Another backup export is already running in this session.
shell_ui.title: DSH Ocean signed shell updates
shell_ui.confirm_enroll: Enable a separate owned user destination? This does not replace your package/current executable or grant authority from an APPIMAGE/path hint. Unknown existing contents are refused.
shell_ui.confirm_transaction: Run this explicit local transaction? It cannot be cancelled once applying/rolling back/recovering. The running client and core/profile are unchanged; quit and reopen the managed launcher afterward.
shell_ui.format_changed: Format preference changed; check the signed feed again.
shell_status.notice_cancel: — cancellation requested; waiting for owned cleanup
shell_status.result_cancelled: Cancelled; no new operation will be started from this result.
shell_status.result_refreshed: Local state refreshed. No network request was made.
shell_status.result_channel: Channel saved. Check again; previous candidates were invalidated. Core channel here is for signed runtime updates, not the old npm selector.
shell_status.result_enrolled: Explicit managed destination enabled. This does not replace or convert the original package installation.
shell_status.result_checked: Signature, policy and remembered floor checked. Artifact has NOT been downloaded or applied.
shell_status.result_downloaded: Exact signed artifact downloaded/hashed into private non-executable staging. Nothing is active yet.
shell_status.result_changed:
Local transaction completed; selection changed on disk only. Running client/core/profile are unchanged. {launcher}
Quit this client using its Quit action, then open DSH Ocean (managed) from the application menu. Closing to tray is not quitting.
shell_status.worker_failed: native worker terminated; refresh local status and inspect pending recovery
shell_report.trust_unavailable: Updater trust is not configured or local configuration could not be read. Ask the owner/distribution to provision independently authenticated public trust. Advanced: dsh-ocean --configure-updates CONFIG --confirm-shell-key SHA256 (runtime root is separate). No key is discovered from a feed.
shell_report.unchanged: Original installation and running process are unchanged
installation.appimage.label: AppImage environment (unverified)
installation.appimage.evidence: APPIMAGE environment hint only; image identity was not verified.
installation.appimage.guidance: If this shell was installed as an AppImage, use its original distribution method. Verify independently authenticated signed release metadata and final bytes before any manual replacement. Offline verification/staging is not installation.
installation.flatpak.label: Flatpak environment (unverified)
installation.flatpak.evidence: FLATPAK_ID environment hint only; this application's package ownership was not verified.
installation.flatpak.guidance: If installed through Flatpak, use that Flatpak installation's update mechanism. Do not replace files inside a sandbox/container manually.
installation.development.label: Development path (heuristic)
installation.development.evidence: Executable path resembles a local Cargo target build; this is a path heuristic.
installation.development.guidance: For a development build, update the trusted checkout and rebuild. This screen neither pulls source nor overwrites the running executable.
installation.system.label: System prefix (ownership unknown)
installation.system.evidence: Executable is under a conventional system prefix; package ownership was not queried.
installation.system.guidance: Use the original installer/package manager. For AUR/Arch use your package workflow; for deb/rpm use that package manager. Do not overwrite a package-owned executable with an AppImage/tarball. Confirm ownership independently.
installation.conflicting.label: Conflicting hints (installation unknown)
installation.conflicting.evidence: Conflicting inherited environment/path hints; install type is not established.
installation.conflicting.guidance: Determine the actual installation source before updating. Use its original package manager or distribution method; do not infer ownership from environment variables.
installation.unknown.label: Unknown installation
installation.unknown.evidence: No reliable installation context hint is available.
installation.unknown.guidance: Determine the original installation method and use its update workflow. No automatic shell replacement is offered for an unclassified installation.
